newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times page one - Sept 18.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times page one - Sept 18.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following stories on its front page on Wednesday:
* The Commission on Presidential Debates chose not to invite Reform Party candidate Ross Perot because it believes he is unelectable.
* Republican presidential nominee Bob Dole reinforced his belief in his proposed 15-percent tax cut as he campaigned in Michigan.
* Political, "issue-oriented" adverstisements are not new, but recent court decisions have paved the way for a significant expansion of their use.
* Bosnian voters elected the existing leaders of the country's three major ethnic groups.
* The new contract between the Ford Motor Co and the United Auto Workers union addresses two issues that have haunted organized labor for more than a decade: layoffs and outsourcing.
* A new study shows that the use of catheters in treating heart disease may be ineffective or even cause greater harm.
* In the past few years, Zaire's Mbuji-Mayi province has reinvented itself as autonomous and self-sufficient.
* The civil trial against O.J. Simpson began with court rulings that will make it difficult for Simpson to employ tactics that helped his acquittal in the criminal trial.
